summary: A wristwatch on the left forearm: a round case, a bezel, a face and a two-piece strap. options channel0, channel1; sockets grip_r, grip_l, holster_r, sling_back.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.garment_accessory_watch_plain or place "prefab": "garment_accessory_watch_plain" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
